meta.name: browser-automation
meta.description: Use when the user asks to automate browser tasks, scrape websites, fill forms, capture screenshots, extract structured data from web pages, or build web automation workflows. NOT for testing — use playwright-pro for that.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行浏览器操作，如填表、截图和提取数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用脚本控制浏览器完成重复性网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script browser actions for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Playwright 自动操作浏览器，包括抓取网页数据、填写表单、截图、提取结构化信息，并管理会话和反检测。
howto.when: 当你要求自动化浏览器任务，如抓取网站、填写表单、截图、提取网页数据或构建自动化工作流时触发。不用于测试。

say.text: 帮我抓取这个网页上的产品列表，包括名称和价格。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Playwright 脚本提取数据。

say.text: 自动登录这个网站，然后下载报告。
say.note: Claude 会编写登录和下载自动化流程。

say.text: 给这个页面截图，保存为PDF。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser tasks using Playwright, including scraping data, filling forms, taking screenshots, extracting structured information, and managing sessions with anti-detection patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate browser tasks such as scraping websites, filling forms, capturing screenshots, extracting web data, or building automation workflows. Not for testing.

say_en.text: Scrape the product list from this page, including names and prices.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a Playwright script to extract data.

say_en.text: Automate login to this site and download the report.
say_en.note: Claude will write a login and download automation flow.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of this page and save it as PDF.
say_en.note: Claude will use Playwright to capture screenshot and generate PDF.
